scope: All production Java sources in core/src/main/java; no production changes required.

compile.bootClasspath: Official Android SDK Platform 29 android.jar plus a compile-only LambdaMetafactory signature stub; no host JDK runtime classes.
compile.compileOnlyBootstrap: LambdaMetafactory signatures allow javac lambda generation. The stub is not packaged; Android D8 desugars lambdas.

limitations: Compile and symbol checks establish core Java API compatibility, not HarmonyOS device certification. Native Android UI, permissions, MediaStore, foreground service and the signed APK need separate emulator/device checks.
Gson internals are not covered by this application member-reference audit. Its pinned official release README states minimum Android API 21; packaged runtime behavior requires smoke tests.
